moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-random-tilt-scale-in, written here): Split chars; each from scale 0.6 and a seeded rotation within ±20° → 1, 0°, opacity full by 40 % (×2.5), 0.9 s power4.out (easeOutQuint), stagger 80 ms (demo capped 0.7 s total), from 0.3 s. Loop exit: fade 2.65–2.95 s inCubic; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.9 s) · stagger (0.08 s) · scale đầu (0.6) · tilt: góc nghiêng ngẫu nhiên (±20°) · ease (power4.out).
